purpose: Measure operational readiness of Manus skills without requiring ownership metadata.

evidence: SKILL.md exists in the skill root
YAML frontmatter has name and description
no ignored operating-system metadata is tracked
description explains the purpose and use condition
test card provides at least one positive and one negative invocation case
body provides an ordered workflow, decision rule, process, or checklist
test card declares the expected outcome
SKILL.md stays at or below 500 lines, or has an explicit exception
long or variant-specific guidance is reachable through references
skill has a structured test card
validation, test, check, or acceptance evidence is stated
failure, retry, fallback, refusal, or safety condition is documented when relevant
sensitive integration skills identify confirmation and secret-handling boundaries
registry records a source-of-truth category and last verification date when the skill contains time-sensitive information
